description.narrative:
The project will be contributing to Palestinian women and youth live free of GBV, with their SRHR fulfilled. PFPPA is very keen to reduce gender inequality and empowering women and girl. PFPPA believes that barriers in access to services and information, specifically for poor women and girls, affect their ability to practice free choice and participate meaningfully across social, economic, and political life. PFPPA will continue their efforts to support an enabling environment so that SRHR and gender equality become a certainty.
The project aims to provide a comprehensive range of affordable, high-quality, and person-centered Family Planning (FP) and Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (SRHR) care to 35,000 people annually through the five PFPPA Service Delivery points located in the West Bank; Hebron, Ramallah, Bethlehem, Youth Center in Hebron and Halhoul. Male engagement is a key componenet of the project throughout all the activities to achieve more effective and sustainable results.
PFPPA is committed to advocate to overcome cultural laws and assure that legislations adopt and imposes laws/ policies to guard youth, women, and high-risk groups from violence. PFPPA has established and is a member of several coalitions and working groups that affect and advocate towards modifying laws/ policies that protect SRHR for all.
On the other hand, and to gain the support and increase public awareness on SRHR, PFPPA will conduct trainings for media students on SRH&R and the significance in the role they can play in supporting and campaigning for related rights and services. In addition to providing Comprehensive Sexuality Education (CSE) sessions and trainings in rural Palestinian communities the targeted areas specially in Area C and Jerusalem.
